meanings.usage: 此处表示对小礼物的喜爱和重视，后面可直接接名词作宾语

meanings.meaning: 便士（英国货币单位，penny的复数形式）
meanings.usage: 是英国辅币单位，100便士等于1英镑
用于形容人在花钱上很节省，褒义词
指物体碰到硬面后弹回，也可指人蹦跳着走
英式英语用词，对应美式英语的sidewalk
此处指路边的排水设施，作动词时意为“排空，流干”
指衣服的袖子部分，常见搭配roll up sleeves意为“卷起袖子，准备大干”
指用作润滑的油脂，也可指烹饪产生的油脂
常用搭配reward sb with sth，意为“用某物奖励某人”
此处指硬币在存钱罐里碰撞发出声响
用于修饰名词，表示超出常规的部分
表示一笔钱时，常用small/large sum来描述金额大小

phrases.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，前面加金额，后面接名词，说明价值对应的物品

examples.en: I bought ten dollars' worth of snacks for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我买了价值十美元的零食用于野餐。

examples.en: He gave me two yuan worth of stamps.
examples.zh: 他给了我价值两元的邮票。

phrases.usage: 表示（钱、物品等）可以用很长时间，很经花；也可表示“大有帮助”

examples.en: A little kindness will go a long way when you meet people in trouble.
examples.zh: 当你遇到有困难的人时，一点善意会帮上大忙。

examples.en: If you are careful, this bottle of milk will go a long way.
examples.zh: 如果你省着点用，这瓶牛奶可以喝很久。

phrases.usage: 表示“把……兑换成/换成……”，用于物品或货币的交换

examples.en: You can exchange your leftover foreign currency for local money at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在机场把剩下的外币兑换成当地货币。

examples.en: He exchanged his old phone for a new one by paying extra money.
examples.zh: 他补了差价，把旧手机换成了新的。

phrases.usage: 表示“偶然到达，最终进入”，主语常是物，暗含“不经意间去到某个地方”的含义

examples.en: Many of the books I bought never found their way to the bookshelf; they just stayed on my desk.
examples.zh: 我买的很多书从来没被放到书架上，就一直摆在我的书桌上。

examples.en: The lost key finally found its way into my jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 那把丢失的钥匙最后居然在我夹克口袋里找到了。

phrases.usage: 字面意思是卷起袖子，常引申为“准备动手干活，准备大干一场”

examples.en: After finishing the plan, we rolled up our sleeves and started the project.
examples.zh: 完成计划后，我们撸起袖子开始做这个项目。

examples.en: Roll up your sleeves; we have a lot of dishes to wash today.
examples.zh: 准备干活吧，我们今天有好多盘子要洗。

phrases.usage: 插入语，意为“而且，更重要的是”，用于补充说明更严重或更重要的情况

examples.en: It's difficult to finish this task in one day, and what is more, we don't have enough tools.
examples.zh: 一天内完成这个任务很难，而且我们还没有足够的工具。

examples.en: The hotel is not comfortable, and what is more, it's far from the city center.
examples.zh: 这家酒店住起来不舒服，而且离市中心还很远。

grammar.title: 一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他
grammar.definition: 用于描述不受时间限制的客观真理、普遍存在的事实或者经常性的习惯动作 当描述大众普遍认可的规律、常态情况时，不管上下文其他时态，都用一般现在时

examples.en: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
examples.zh: 孩子们总是喜欢得到一些小额零花钱作为礼物。

examples.en: The earth moves around the sun.

grammar.title: because引导的原因状语从句
grammar.structure: 主句 + because + 从句，或者Because + 从句, + 主句
grammar.definition: 用来解释主句动作发生的原因，是最常用的原因状语从句引导词 可以用来回答why提出的问题，从句说明直接、明确的原因

examples.en: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.
examples.zh: 乔治对这次经历并没有太难过，因为糖果店的女老板听说了他遇到的麻烦，奖励了他一大盒巧克力。

examples.en: I stayed at home yesterday because it was raining heavily.
examples.zh: 我昨天待在家里，因为当时雨下得很大。

patterns.pattern: A is a small price to pay for B.

original.en: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.
original.zh: 对他们中的大多数人来说，花50便士买一大块好吃的巧克力是很值的。

imitations.en: For many students, two hours' study every day is a small price to pay for a good score in the exam.
imitations.zh: 对很多学生来说，每天学习两小时，用来换取考试的好成绩是很划算的。

imitations.en: I think getting up early is a small price to pay for the beautiful sunrise on the mountain.
imitations.zh: 我觉得为了看山上美丽的日出，早起一点是完全值得的。

original.en: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it. Instead, he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.
original.zh: 我昨天给了他50便士，劝他存起来。可他却用这50便士给自己买了麻烦。

imitations.en: My mom told me to finish my homework first. Instead, I played computer games for three hours.
imitations.zh: 我妈妈让我先写完作业。我反而玩了三个小时的电脑游戏。

imitations.en: The doctor advised him to stop drinking alcohol. Instead, he drank even more than before.
imitations.zh: 医生建议他戒酒。他反而喝得比以前更多了。

patterns.pattern: Sb did sth, and what is more, sb could not do sth.

original.en: He could not find his 50 pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
original.zh: 他到处都找不到那50便士，而且他的胳膊还拔不出来了。

imitations.en: He missed the last bus home, and what is more, he forgot to take his house key with him.
imitations.zh: 他错过了回家的末班车，而且他还忘带家门钥匙了。

imitations.en: The team lost the important match, and what is more, their best player got injured during the game.
imitations.zh: 球队输掉了这场重要的比赛，而且他们最好的球员还在比赛中受了伤。

lines.en: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
lines.zh: 孩子们总是喜欢得到一些零花钱。

lines.en: Mum or dad, of course, provide a regular supply of pocket money, but uncles and ants are always a source of extra income.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈当然经常给孩子零花钱，但是，叔舅婶姨也是孩子们额外收入来源。

lines.en: With some children, small sums go a long way.
lines.zh: 对于有些孩子来说，少量的钱可以花很长一段时间。

lines.en: If fifty pence pieces are not exchanged for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes. Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.
lines.zh: 如果50便士不拿来换糖吃，则可以放在储蓄罐里叮当响上好几月。

lines.en: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.
lines.zh: 但是能把储蓄罐装满的只有屈指可数的几个特别节俭的孩子。

lines.en: My nephew, George, has a money box but it is always empty.
lines.zh: 对大部分孩子来说，用50便士来买一大块好的巧克力，是算不了什么的。

lines.en: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
lines.zh: 我的外甥乔治有一个储蓄罐，但总是空空的。

lines.en: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.
lines.zh: 我给了不少50便士的硬币，但没有几个存到储蓄罐里。

lines.en: Instead he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.
lines.zh: 昨天，我给了他50便士让存起来，却拿这钱给自己买了50便士的麻烦。

lines.en: On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
lines.zh: 在他去糖果店的路上，50便士掉在地上，在人行道上跳了几下，掉进了阴沟里。

lines.en: George took off his jacket, rolled up his sleeves and pushed is right arm through the drain cover.
lines.zh: 乔治脱掉外套，卷起袖子，将右胳膊伸进了阴沟盖。

lines.en: He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could no get his arm out.
lines.zh: 但他摸了半天也没找到那50便士硬币，他的胳膊反倒退不出来了。

lines.en: A crowd of people gathered round him and a lady rubbed his arm with soap and butter, but George was firmly stuck.
lines.zh: 这时在他周围上了许多人，一位女士在乔治胳膊上抹了肥皂，黄油，但乔治的胳膊仍然卡得紧紧的。

lines.en: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighter freed George using a special type of grease .
lines.zh: 有人打电话叫来消防队，两位消防队员使用了一种特殊的润滑剂才使乔治得以解脱。

lines.en: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with large box of chocolates.
lines.zh: 不过，此事并没使乔治过于伤心，因为糖果店老板娘听说了他遇到的麻烦后，赏给他一大盒巧克力。

questions.q: Did George get anything for his fifty pence? What?
questions.zh: 乔治的五十便士换来了什么吗？换来了什么？
questions.a: Yes, he did. He did not get the sweets he wanted, but he ended up with a large box of chocolates from the owner of the sweet shop.
questions.aZh: 换来了。他没买成想要的糖，却从糖果店老板娘那里得到了一大盒巧克力。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后一句：the lady who owns the sweet shop ... rewarded him with large box of chocolates.

questions.q: What do most children do with fifty pence, and what kind of children manage to fill up a money box?
questions.zh: 大部分孩子拿五十便士做什么？什么样的孩子才能把储蓄罐装满？
questions.a: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate. Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.
questions.aZh: 对大部分孩子来说，五十便士买一大块好巧克力算不了什么；只有特别节俭的孩子才能把储蓄罐装满。

questions.q: What happened to George's fifty pence on his way to the sweet shop?
questions.zh: 乔治去糖果店的路上，那五十便士怎么了？
questions.a: He dropped it, and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
questions.aZh: 他把钱掉了，硬币在人行道上弹跳了几下，然后掉进了阴沟里。
questions.hint: 见课文第10句 On his way to the sweet shop...

questions.q: How was George finally freed from the drain cover?
questions.zh: 乔治最后是怎么从阴沟盖里脱身的？
questions.a: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighters freed him using a special type of grease.
questions.aZh: 有人叫来了消防队，两名消防员用一种特殊的润滑剂才使他脱身。

questions.q: Why was George not too upset by his experience?
questions.zh: 为什么乔治对这次经历并不太难过？
questions.a: Because the lady who owned the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates, so he got something sweet out of it.
questions.aZh: 因为糖果店老板娘听说了他的遭遇后，赏了他一大盒巧克力，所以他反倒得了甜头。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句的 because 从句。

translation:
孩子们总是喜欢得到一些零花钱。
爸爸妈妈当然经常给孩子零花钱，但是，叔舅婶姨也是孩子们额外收入来源。
对于有些孩子来说，少量的钱可以花很长一段时间。
如果50便士不拿来换糖吃，则可以放在储蓄罐里叮当响上好几月。
但是能把储蓄罐装满的只有屈指可数的几个特别节俭的孩子。
对大部分孩子来说，用50便士来买一大块好的巧克力，是算不了什么的。
我的外甥乔治有一个储蓄罐，但总是空空的。
我给了不少50便士的硬币，但没有几个存到储蓄罐里。
昨天，我给了他50便士让存起来，却拿这钱给自己买了50便士的麻烦。
在他去糖果店的路上，50便士掉在地上，在人行道上跳了几下，掉进了阴沟里。
乔治脱掉外套，卷起袖子，将右胳膊伸进了阴沟盖。
但他摸了半天也没找到那50便士硬币，他的胳膊反倒退不出来了。
这时在他周围上了许多人，一位女士在乔治胳膊上抹了肥皂，黄油，但乔治的胳膊仍然卡得紧紧的。
有人打电话叫来消防队，两位消防队员使用了一种特殊的润滑剂才使乔治得以解脱。
不过，此事并没使乔治过于伤心，因为糖果店老板娘听说了他遇到的麻烦后，赏给他一大盒巧克力。
title: Fifty Pence Worth of Trouble
subtitle: 五十便士的麻烦

lead.question: 乔治用五十便士买了什么让他陷入麻烦的东西？最后他又得到了什么？
lead.warmup: 先回想自己的存钱经历：爸爸妈妈给的零花钱，你是一分一分攒进储蓄罐，还是转身就跑去了糖果店花个精光？课文里的男孩乔治也有个储蓄罐，却总是空空如也。叔叔给他五十便士，本想让他存起来，他反过来给自己买了一场麻烦。读课文时留意：钱是怎么从他手里溜走的，最后又是谁赏了他一份甜头。
goals: 掌握 pocket money、money box、thrifty、sweet shop 等与零花钱、糖果相关的词汇。
理解 go a long way、find one's way、what is more、exchange...for... 等固定表达。
辨析 fifty pence pieces 与 fifty pennies 的用法差异。
体会一般过去时叙述事件与现在完成时总结经历的搭配。
lead.summary: 课文先谈孩子对零花钱的态度：少量钱也能花很久，只有特别节俭的孩子才装得满储蓄罐。接着讲外甥乔治：他有个空储蓄罐，叔叔给的钱大多没存进去。昨天他拿五十便士去糖果店，硬币掉进阴沟，他伸手去掏，胳膊反被阴沟盖卡住，消防队用特殊润滑剂才把他救出。糖果店老板娘听说后，赏了他一大盒巧克力。
lead.tips: fifty pence pieces 指若干枚五十便士的硬币，复数仍用 pence；fifty pennies 则是五十枚一便士硬币，两者别混淆。

exercises.q: 汉译英：爸爸妈妈当然经常给孩子零花钱。
exercises.a: Mum or dad, of course, provide a regular supply of pocket money.

exercises.q: 汉译英：对于有些孩子来说，少量的钱可以花很长一段时间。
exercises.a: With some children, small sums go a long way.
exercises.note: go a long way 可以维持很久

exercises.q: 填空：If fifty pence pieces are not ______ for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes.
句型转换：用 what is more 把 "He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere. He could not get his arm out." 合并为一句。
exercises.a: He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
exercises.note: what is more 更有甚者

exercises.q: 改错：Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I gave him have found their way there.
exercises.a: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
exercises.note: give 用现在完成时 have given

exercises.q: 填空并辨析：a fifty ______ piece 指一枚五十便士硬币，而 fifty ______ 指五十枚一便士硬币。
exercises.note: pence 与 pennies 的区别

exercises.q: 汉译英：昨天我给了他五十便士，并建议他把它存起来。
exercises.a: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.
exercises.note: advise sb. to do 建议某人做某事

quiz.q: 课文开头说，孩子们总是喜欢什么？
options: small gifts of money
big boxes of chocolates
new money boxes
regular supplies of sweets
quiz.note: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.

quiz.q: 在课文中，除了父母，谁还是孩子额外收入的来源？
options: Teachers and friends
Uncles and aunts
Brothers and sisters
Neighbours and strangers
quiz.note: uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income

quiz.q: "small sums go a long way" 在文中是什么意思？
options: Small sums last a long time.
Small sums are quickly spent.
Small sums are hard to save.
Small sums are worth little.
quiz.note: go a long way = 可以维持很久

quiz.q: 乔治的储蓄罐为什么总是空空的？
options: He has no money box at all.
He gives his money to his friends.
Very few of the coins he is given find their way there.
He lost his money box down a drain.
quiz.note: 大多数硬币没能存进储蓄罐

quiz.q: 乔治的五十便士掉进阴沟后，他的胳膊怎么了？
options: He hurt it badly on the pavement.
He could not get it out of the drain cover.
He burned it on the hot pavement.
He dropped it into the money box.
quiz.note: he could not get his arm out

quiz.q: 谁最后让乔治摆脱了困境？
options: A lady with soap and butter
The owner of the sweet shop
Two fire fighters with a special grease
A crowd of people who gathered round him
quiz.note: two fire fighters freed George using a special type of grease
